messages:
maya (ML Eng): Quick heads-up — doing bring-up of qx-2b (quantized) on staging against the promptbank regression suite. Noticing a spike in near-duplicate hits after tokenizer v2 rollout, plus a few golden eval regressions. Can we triage?

sam (LabelOps): Can you paste a couple example IDs so we can pull the labeler queues?

maya (ML Eng): Sure — small sample from the collision cluster:

```
ids: [P-12873, P-12901, P-12902]
sim_scores: [0.98, 0.97, 0.99]
token_hashes:
P-12901: 0x5ac1
P-12902: 0x5ac1
```

anya (Curator): Those look like tokenization collisions to me — v2 normalization strips soft-hyphens and collapses some unicode variants. We saw something similar in the web-scrape batch last month.

dmitri (Infra): Confirmed: tokenizer v2 changed NFC/NFKC path, which can shift token boundaries and therefore the fingerprint. We should run a diff against v1 tokens. Quick command: `python tools/token-compare.py --old tokens_v1.json --new tokens_v2.json --diff-only` — that'll show which entries changed hashes.

sam (LabelOps): For now I'll pause auto-dedupe for the affected shard and create manual review tasks for high-sim pairs (threshold > 0.95). Also recommend we add a small golden sentinel set for these unicode/spacing edgecases so the canary exercises them.

labeler-bot: auto-dedupe pause applied by @sam — manual review task created: LD-482 (requires 2 reviewers). :white_check_mark:

maya (ML Eng): Thanks. For the qx-2b bring-up my proposed plan: 1) manual review of the dupe cluster (LD-482) and mark true duplicates vs tokenization artifacts, 2) assemble a 20-case golden update capturing the edgecases, 3) run a golden-only canary of qx-2b before full bank regression. @dmitri can you kick the canary run once the golden branch is up?

dmitri (Infra): On it — kicking a canary against the `golden-updates/qx2b` branch now. Will run evals + perf smoke. ETA ~30m. I'll post logs here.

leo (SRE): Heads-up: canary will disable batching for deterministic token-level comparisons. I rolled a temporary alert: `canary-latency > 150ms for 5m` — please watch.

maya (ML Eng): :thumbsup: I'll open the PR for the golden additions and include an eval checklist (regen tokens v1/v2, similarity matrix, human labels, and quant vs fp16 outputs).

sam (LabelOps): LabelOps will prioritize LD-482, aiming for two reviewer passes within the hour. If anything looks like a tokenizer-only collision mark as "keep, annotate as tokenizer artifact" so we don't delete good prompts. :eyes:

labeler-bot: LD-482 reviewer assignments: @anya, @sam. Reminder: apply `artifact` tag when appropriate.

maya (ML Eng): Thanks everyone — will post the PR link when ready and add the quick checklist. If the canary shows regression we rollback qx-2b and we keep quant experiments gated on a golden pass.
